unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 12 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.4 - THEME 6: LIFE IN THE WORLD & CULTURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will complete a project about ''Life in the World and Culture'' focusing on how technology and education influence cultural habits. They will begin by examining how technology reshapes cultural traditions such as digital entertainment, social interactions, and online trends. Students will create a short video or a series of photos showing examples of technology influencing cultural habits in their own lives or community. Next, they will explore how education helps preserve culture by learning about school events, subjects, and activities that highlight local traditions and history. Each student will contribute a written reflection or a poster explaining how their school experiences convey cultural values and pass down heritage. They can create their posters with Web 2.0 tools and share them in the classroom. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the world and culture with its components such as the influence of technology on cultural habits; the role of education in preserving culture'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school may know what the influence of technology on cultural habits; the role of education in preserving culture mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in the world and culture'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year, and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 12 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the world and culture with its components such as the influence of technology on cultural habits; the role of education in preserving culture'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss about the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To discuss the influence of technology on cultural habits through a debate and critical thinking by using target vocabulary and language items. Activity 1: Digital vs Traditional The teacher explains that students will debate the influence of technology on cultural habits. S/he divides the students into two groups: one group argues that technology helps preserve culture, while the other group argues that technology harms cultural traditions. After presenting their arguments, each group summarises their key points. The teacher provides constructive and encouraging feedback, focusing on the accuracy, creativity, and cohesion in the use of the target language. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To discuss the influence of technology on cultural habits through a group discussion by using target vocabulary and grammar. Activity 1: Exploring Technology and Culture: A group discussion The teacher introduces the activity by explaining that students will discuss how technology influences their cultural habits in small groups. To guide the discussion, the teacher provides sentence starters such as ''I think AI ____. In my country, we use technology for ____''. ''Technology has made cultural heritage more/ less ____''. Students engage in group discussions, sharing their thoughts and examples. Later, each group presents their ideas to the class. The teacher provides constructive feedback by focusing on language accuracy and creativity in the use of the target language while encouraging further participation. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
